sql: /* Query 10: filter5_join2 (player, team, city, manager) */ SELECT player.position, manager.age, team.championship, city.city_name FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name JOIN manager ON team.ownership = manager.name JOIN city ON team.location = city.city_name WHERE player.olympic_gold_medals = 0 OR player.position <> 'Backcourt' OR city.gdp = '252200'

position.description: player's primary position on the team; choose one from ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt'].

age.description: age is the age of the team owner, a integer (e.g. 45).

championship.description: championships is the number of this team getting championships (e.g. 5).

city_name.description: city_name is the name of the city (e.g. Boston)
